cost_estimate.H1-H6 torus jobs: about 0.5 CPU hours (38.3 million raw codes; 15 to 30 ms per class)
cost_estimate.H7 law jobs: about 2 to 4 CPU hours; at most 19 x 55 minutes; at V = 20 (3x50 (3,5), 5x30 (5,3)) a search with bound V + 1 about 4 to 6 minutes by the extrapolation
cost_estimate.H8/H9 scans, rounds and cross-checks: about 6 to 12 CPU hours on the 9 tori with n <= 252; at most 9 x (4 x 50 + 40) minutes, 36 CPU hours, if every budget is used
cost_estimate.basis: stage 1's search from (0, lm), medians by d and n: 0.03 s at d = 12, 0.2 s at 14, 2 s at 16, 22 s at 18, flat in n from 144 to 198; the current search.c (sha256 d353ead3..., stage 1's) takes 18 s on [[288,12,18]] at n = 288 (docs/code-distances.md; the 3 minutes there were the search before examples/qec-distance-2's fix); so about x10 per +2 in d with no sign of growth in n, extrapolated to about 4 minutes at d = 20, 40 at 22 and 6 hours at 24; the program 28 to 44 s at d = 12, 113 to 314 s at 14 (medians), its 600 s limit at d >= 16 (13 of 13); best d of a k = 8 class on 3 x m from 0.67 m down to 0.48 m (m = 9 to 33), of a k = 4 class about 0.55 m
cost_estimate.calibration: the H8/H9 pipeline without programs on stage-1 tori, with these rounds and limits: 3x33 292 s (scan 215 s, one round of 5 probes), 6x15 297 s (scan 235 s, 4 probes), each finding stage 1's best (with the earlier round order: 3x27 51 s, all exact after the scan); law_record on 7 stage-1 instances, 0.6 to 154 s each with programs
cost_estimate.n = 270 and 288 (not judged): best d expected near 20 to 24, 4 minutes to 6 hours per deep search; six more frontier chains, up to about 24 CPU hours (module docstring, 'Why n <= 252')
cost_estimate.total: about 9 to 18 CPU hours, 3 to 5 hours of wall clock with 4 workers (2 or 3 windows); about 65 CPU hours, some 10 windows, if every budget were used
cost_estimate.windows: every job's timeout at most 55 minutes; a job starts only if its timeout fits in the 115-minute window; a frontier torus's chain fits in 3 windows when every round uses its budget and a worker is free for each job

body.verdict_rule: fail when the instruments fail (H6 finds a problem; a run was not made by the registered protocol, settings or bound rules; a job has two records; an H7 instance is a fault) or a part fails; hold when every part holds or is not applicable, every registered job has a record, no job failed (an error row, or a failed earlier job named in a record's prior_errors), and the pinned files are those registered; incomplete otherwise. A part over its judged items (not exposed): fails if one fails, holds if every one holds (and there is one), incomplete otherwise; H6 over every torus with codes, exposed ones included, 'not tested' if none was tested; H7 by its registered threshold. 'instruments' is fail as above, hold when H6 holds, and otherwise H6's outcome (not tested, or incomplete).

threshold.rule: on the instances not exposed and not proved (m/q > 1): fails if any instance is above, or any instance (proved ones included) is a fault; otherwise inconclusive if fewer than resolved_fraction of them resolve (equal or below; an instance whose job failed or has no record, or that is not tested, counts as unresolved); otherwise holds when at least equal_fraction of the resolved ones are equal, and fails if not. A proved instance (m/q = 1) must be equal: resolved otherwise, it is a fault. A fault is also: the torus job and the law job disagree on the classes of the type, or, where gcd(l, m) = 1, no class has the type; where gcd(l, m) > 1 and no representative has the type, the instance is not tested

body.verdict_rule: fail when the instruments fail (H6 finds a problem; a run was not made by the registered protocol, settings or bound rules; a job has two records; an H7 instance is a fault) or a part fails; hold when every part holds or is not applicable, every registered job has a record, no job failed (an error row, or a failed earlier job named in a record's prior_errors), and the pinned files are those registered; incomplete otherwise. A part over its judged items (not exposed): fails if one fails, holds if every one holds (and there is one), incomplete otherwise; H6 over every torus with codes, exposed ones included, 'not tested' if none was tested; H7 by its registered threshold. 'instruments' is fail as above, hold when H6 holds, and otherwise H6's outcome (not tested, or incomplete).
